description: This file defines an Android activity class EnableProfileActivity, which is responsible for enabling a device profile after provisioning. It interacts with DevicePolicyManager to set the profile name and enable the profile, and provides a UI element to transition to the main activity.

classes.name: EnableProfileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that handles enabling a managed profile post-provisioning and provides navigation to the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, enables the profile if needed, and sets up the UI.

methods.name: enableProfile
methods.description: Uses DevicePolicyManager to set the profile name and enable the profile.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on the view, specifically to start the MainActivity and finish this activity.
